```{r libraries}
library(rgbif)
library(googlesheets4)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r auth}
if(Sys.getenv("amiabot") != "yes"){
  print("Executor of the script is not a bot")
  email <- paste0(Sys.getenv("email"), "@inbo.be")
  gs4_auth(email)
}else{
  print("Executor of the script is a bot")
  gs4_auth(path = Sys.getenv("gsheet_token"))
}
```
